name: Businessman Simulator 3
summary: Become the richest capitalist with a big capital (according to the Vorbis magazine, of course), ahead of other entrepreneurs and their businesses. You will be able to manage businesses: car factory, smartphone factory, oil production, building construction and other companies. They all produce and consume resources. You can sell goods and manage your profit, hire professional managers which can increase your money. Also, there is a huge number of interesting missions. Start your adventure from burger company owner to the richest capitalist right now!
